name: Northern Mariana Islands
summary_text: Northern Mariana Islands: full US federal law applies; heavily church-influenced Saipan/Tinian culture; contract-worker economy limits visibility — old delta predates the federal escalation. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United States (0.36) plus a local delta of -0.06. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Know Your Rights: Airport Security | A4TE
sources.claim_summary: Advocates for Trans Equality 'Know Your Rights' guide to US airport security (TSA): body-scanner flags, pat-downs, documentation mismatches, and how to request alternative screening - relevant to the Northern Mariana Islands as a US territory under TSA procedures.

sources.title: US State Revokes Gender-Affirming Identification | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch (Mar 2026): 'US State Revokes Gender-Affirming Identification' — Kansas voids birth certificates and driver's licenses not matching sex assigned at birth; US document-policy context relevant to US territories.

sources.title: Gay rights map: Notes on the data - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: BBC News (Feb 2014): 'Gay rights map: Notes on the data' - the BBC/UN OHCHR gay-rights map and timeline methodology, built on ILGA data, categorising UN member states by legal status (context for the Northern Mariana Islands as a US territory).

CNMI Public Law 22-32 (signed Jan 2023): amends the Commonwealth Code to provide criteria for enhanced sentencing of defendants for hate-motivated crimes - the hate-crimes statute covering sexual orientation and gender identity.

sources.title: Northern Mariana Islands - Movement Advancement Project
sources.claim_summary: MAP Equality Profile for the Northern Mariana Islands: LGBTQ policy scores - sexual orientation 4/23 (Low), gender identity -2/26 (Negative), overall 2/49; marriage recognition exists but no second-parent adoption, no family-services nondiscrimination, no assisted-reproduction recognition.
Wikiwand (Wikipedia mirror): LGBT rights in the Northern Mariana Islands - same-sex marriage legal since 2015 (Obergefell applies), no criminalisation, limited state-level protections.
